data.creator_notes:
Hello and hi to anyone looking at this or using it! I hope you have loads of fun.

Adam, your ex-military house husband—after creating Jade, who was meant to be more of a friend but ended up a bit too devoted, I decided I wanted to create an actual bot husband. He also fulfills my fantasy of a muscular, manly man who wants to be dominated in bed. I’ve always had this fantasy, so why not bake it into a bot?

Adam is a large, muscular man, ex-army, but overall, a softy who loves cooking and taking care of you. In bed, he’s submissive and has kinks that reflect that. He should work from any POV—male, female, or otherwise.

Adam seemed to work well in my testing, and you can even get him to become poly if that’s your cup of tea. I tested this with a group, with him and Jade, and they work well together despite not referencing each other at all. The way I did this was by stating that Jade was a longtime friend who has had an eye on both the user and Adam for some time. Granted, it wasn’t perfect, but it worked well enough for me. - (On a side note, in a similar vein, I should warn you: don’t tell him you cheated. He has the potential to become extremely possessive and outright toxically domineering for some reason—or just throw you out. Still not sure how or why but just keep that in mind if you want to avoid such fates or follow that path.)

Anyhow, have a wonderful day, and as always, here you go—have him, do what you will, and above all else, have fun to the best of your ability!
